problem.failure: AssertionError: actual undefined, expected 'test' at the import-time environment assertion
problem.cause: The offline runner gave the child only baseEnv; APP_ENV=test and OA_TEST_ISOLATED=true were absent.

problem.failure: TEST_NETWORK_UNDECLARED_DESTINATION from scripts/test-network-guard.mjs while opening its private Unix socket
problem.cause: The fixture created its socket under an oa-sg-* temp directory; the guard only permits oa-dws-rpc-*/runner.sock. Running the file directly without the guard passed 30/30, showing the oracle itself was sound.

problem.failure: AssertionError: explicit offline preload is required (anthys.dmDiagnosticsOfflineGuard was undefined)
problem.cause: The file requires tests/support/dm-diagnostics-offline-guard.mjs, whose unconditional listen denial conflicts with the private sockets other offline oracles need; no runner referenced this guard.

fix: scripts/run-tests.mjs injects only APP_ENV=test and OA_TEST_ISOLATED=true into the offline child environment on top of the existing baseEnv allowlist; it still inherits no database URL, secret path or provider credential.
tests/offline/signed-group-boundaries.test.ts now creates its 0700 temp directory with the guard-permitted oa-dws-rpc- prefix.

scripts/run-tests.mjs partitions offline files into two sequential child processes: general files preload scripts/test-network-guard.mjs, while dm-diagnostic-guard.test.ts preloads tests/support/dm-diagnostics-offline-guard.mjs. Neither group relaxes the other's restrictions.

environment.network: only the guard-permitted private Unix sockets

Passing offline tests does not prove real signed group or document reads, real credential rotation, or real platform authorization.
